content: Chromium/Electron IME on Wayland: native Wayland mode needs --enable-wayland-ime --wayland-text-input-version=3 (+ --ozone-platform=wayland) on Electron>=28/newer Chromium; Electron #33662: gtk-version=4 flag crashes Electron (links GTK3); VS Code #120084: GTK im modules not loaded under Wayland ozone; XWayland path uses XIM and shows fast-typing character reordering (blog.040304.xyz). Mutter only supported text-input-v1 early (GNOME-specific), KDE-oriented zwp protocols mismatch. E2E matrix must pin Chrome flags and expect different behavior per windowing mode.
